limits: Local derivative around deterministic exchange-symmetric reference, not a global threshold or the stochastic expected trajectory.

Gaussian expectation approximated by a fixed nested bank of 1024/2048 draws; imposed exact permutation symmetry for equal-strength reference groups in both first moments and pair derivatives. Quadrature sensitivity not an empirical CI.
ABM small but finite initial difference, 128 replicates from PR121 same seed; local sign comparison conditional on 96 chosen cells, not independent prediction evidence.
The pair share and derivative depend on time, competing latent strengths, and alpha itself; a state-specific inequality is not a single exogenous critical alpha.
Synthetic aggregate support counts only, no real market or participant identification, causal or genetic claim, actual prices or wagering.
